material_news_signals.body_text: aaron donald returned to the field on monday night and so did the los angeles rams offense which was absent in week 1 the two felt intertwined in the 28 6 blowout victory over the new york giants at sofi stadium monday marked donald s first game back since he retired after the 2023 season i was so juiced he came running out of the tunnel and i couldn t control myself matthew stafford said of donald s return i was freaking fired up i m sure y all were in there the fans were happy to see him back and we all were too just the human being the player all of it combined what he brings to our team and to our locker room is unmatched and really to the city which i thought was amazing i thought it was a great reception for him tonight well deserved the juiced stafford went out and ripped apart the banged up giants secondary whipping four touchdowns on 22 of 31 passes for 327 yards new york pressured stafford on just 15 2 of his dropbacks the fourth lowest rate he has faced in a game as a ram since 2021 per next gen stats when kept clean he completed 20 of 27 attempts for 302 yards including all four touchdowns and his lone interception which was a heat check deep shot in the second quarter despite not having all pro receiver puka nacua stafford moved the ball at will feeding davante adams the reigning mvp hit adams with 8 passes for 195 yards and two tds the rest of the rams offense combined for 132 receiving yards he s wide receiver one to me he ain t a two head coach sean mcvay said of adams he was special and it showed all night that s what he s consistently done and i m really happy for him i thought he made some great plays but you could see there s a lot of trust that he and matthew have they were able to get a lot of work together this offseason and it s only going to continue to build i was really happy for him he did his thing tonight according to opta stats the most yards by a qb receiver duo 33 or older in a game in nfl history is 289 by steve young and jerry rice on dec 18 1995 stafford and adams came in no 2 on monday with 195 a week after struggling to move the ball consistently against the 49ers in australia the rams moved unimpeded through the big blue defense gobbling up 481 yards and 23 first downs they converted 5 of 9 third downs and went 3 of 3 in the red zone outside of two turnovers in the second quarter l a did whatever it wanted with donald returning the rams d played with a little more fire and rattled backup quarterback jameis winston who was thrust into action after jaxson dart s first drive injury playing a more physical brand of defense than a week ago l a gave up just 182 total yards 11 first downs and two field goals donald noted that the speed of the game didn t feel like too much after two years off the game really wasn t as fast as i thought he said it was more of me calming myself down overrunning stuff or just my feet not being in the ground how they supposed to be not trusting my eyes little stuff like that but playing the game when i held out in 17 18 it was the same way when i came back it took a couple games to get going it s a little different i ain t played in two years so i gotta watch the film see what i did good see what i did wrong and just clean it up in his return donald had three tackles including one for loss and one quarterback pressure on 18 pass rushes tied for his career low per next gen stats after last week s dismal performance against san francisco the rams got back on track at home mcvay even took a shot at himself for the australia travel plans which were roundly panned after the blowout loss sometimes you win sometimes you learn he said sometimes you have a dumbass coach that makes travel plans that put you in a bad spot so there you go that s a dropped mic

material_news_signals.description: Hall of Fame QB Drew Brees says he reached out to the Broncos about a potential comeback prior to last season's AFC Championship Game.
material_news_signals.body_text: ahead of last week s tilt between the broncos and chiefs espn reported that the broncos reached out to drew brees prior to last season s afc championship game about a potential return the news caused a kerfuffle in denver with head coach sean payton saying last week that he d never heard of brees comeback consideration during monday s episode of the let s go podcast on siriusxm co host jim gray asked brees how close he was to actually giving it a shot to return well i d say this so my wrist and my shoulder i don t throw with my right side anymore he said i mean i could throw it 10 yards and it s with a lot of pain you know so that s definitely not gonna get the job done now my mind my body everything else feels great but my right wrist right shoulder wouldn t allow it to happen but did i think about it absolutely 1 000 percent i would ve loved to come back and play for the broncos in the afc championship game get my coach and a bunch of the other guys that i know in that organization the penner family to the super bowl would ve loved it the physical inability was one reason brees couldn t make a comeback the other is that he remains on the new orleans saints reserve retired list brees said it was during his pro football hall of fame door knock that he truly thought about the possibility of returning the hof qb noted that he initiated a text to then broncos assistants pete carmichael and joe lombardi here s the story so i get the knock from the hall of fame i get the knock literally on monday january 19 it was the day after the divisional round where the news had come out that bo nix had hurt his foot he was gonna be out brees said so jim porter who s the president of the hall of fame we re there we re having this moment dan fouts is telling me i m in the hall of fame and i look at jim porter and said well i guess this means i can t go back and play for the broncos this week and he goes actually you can do whatever you want he said voting s already been done you re in you can do whatever you want and so i m telling you when i say i like flipped the switch i flipped the switch immediately texted pete carmichael and joe lombardi my oc and quarterback coach with the saints they were with the broncos i said you guys need me this week i said i might be able to be ready and they re like are you serious we ll go down and tell sean right now i said wait let me get up tomorrow let me give this thing a go so i got up the next morning and i gave it a go i had my 13 year old son catching balls for me in the backyard and man it just was not happening with the right side left side inside the 20 i would have been lethal at least could have gotten them in and out of the right plays but no it wasn t going to happen added brees that was the end of it yeah texted them back and said ah look i ll be there for moral support the moral support went for naught on that day the broncos started backup jarrett stidham in nix s stead and lost 10 7 to the patriots in rough weather conditions
